name: b1-처음-가려진이름표
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h = 0.3) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hidden = () => v.labels.filter(l => l.userData.hidden).map(l => l.element.textContent); return 'ok' })()
after: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h = 0.3) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hidden = () => v.labels.filter(l => l.userData.hidden).map(l => l.element.textContent); return { 가려진이름표: hidden() } })()

name: b3-거실창-창턱벽색
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h = 0.3) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hidden = () => v.labels.filter(l => l.userData.hidden).map(l => l.element.textContent); document.querySelector('[data-tab=finish]').click(); const s = document.getElementById('finish-room'); s.value = '거실'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); [...document.querySelectorAll('#wall-chips .chip')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('라이트 그레이')).click(); const cx = M.extent[0]/2, cz = M.extent[1]/2; v.camera.position.set(4.7 - cx, 1.5, 5.6 - cz); v.controls.target.set(4.7 - cx, 0.6, 7.9 - cz); v.controls.update(); return st().walls['거실'] })()

name: b4-비스듬히-소파끌기정확도
dragJs: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h = 0.3) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hidden = () => v.labels.filter(l => l.userData.hidden).map(l => l.element.textContent); document.getElementById('view-oblique').click(); v.controls.update(); const s = st().furniture.sofa; window.__grab = scr(s.at[0], s.at[1], 0.52); const end = scr(s.at[0] - 0.5, s.at[1] + 0.3, 0.52); window.__end = end; return [...window.__grab, ...end] })()
after: (() => { const v = __viewer; const M = window.APT_MODEL; const cv = document.querySelector('#stage canvas').getBoundingClientRect(); const scr = (x, y, h = 0.3) => { const p = new v.THREE.Vector3(x - M.extent[0]/2, h, y - M.extent[1]/2).project(v.camera); return [cv.left + (p.x+1)/2*cv.width, cv.top + (1-p.y)/2*cv.height] }; const st = () => v.state; const hidden = () => v.labels.filter(l => l.userData.hidden).map(l => l.element.textContent); const s = st().furniture.sofa; const now = scr(s.at[0], s.at[1], 0.52); return { 소파: s.at, 마우스끝: window.__end.map(n => Math.round(n)), 소파중심화면: now.map(n => Math.round(n)), 오차px: Math.round(Math.hypot(now[0] - window.__end[0], now[1] - window.__end[1])) } })()
